module origen_201982(
    input clock_in,
    input reset_in,
    output reg [7:0] lcd_data,
    output reg lcd_e,
    output reg lcd_rw,
    output reg lcd_rs
);

reg [15:0] clk_div;
reg [3:0] state;
reg [7:0] dat;
reg [4:0] cnt;

always @(posedge clock_in or posedge reset_in) begin
    if (reset_in) begin
        clk_div <= 0;
        state <= 1;
        cnt <= 0;
        dat <= 0;
        lcd_e <= 0;
        lcd_rw <= 0;
        lcd_rs <= 0;
    end
    else begin
        clk_div <= clk_div + 1;

        case (state)
            1: begin // Clear display
                if (cnt == 15) begin
                    lcd_data <= 8'h01;
                    lcd_rw <= 0;
                    lcd_rs <= 0;
                    execute;
                    state <= 2;
                    cnt <= 0;
                end
                else begin
                    cnt <= cnt + 1;
                end
            end
            2: begin // Set 8-bit data mode, 2-line display, 5x8 dot matrix
                if (cnt == 15) begin
                    lcd_data <= 8'h38;
                    lcd_rw <= 0;
                    lcd_rs <= 0;
                    execute;
                    state <= 3;
                    cnt <= 0;
                end
                else begin
                    cnt <= cnt + 1;
                end
            end
            3: begin // Set entry mode to increment address, no display shift
                if (cnt == 15) begin
                    lcd_data <= 8'h06;
                    lcd_rw <= 0;
                    lcd_rs <= 0;
                    execute;
                    state <= 4;
                    cnt <= 0;
                end
                else begin
                    cnt <= cnt + 1;
                end
            end
            4: begin // Turn on display, no cursor, no blinking
                if (cnt == 15) begin
                    lcd_data <= 8'h0C;
                    lcd_rw <= 0;
                    lcd_rs <= 0;
                    execute;
                    state <= 5;
                    cnt <= 0;
                end
                else begin
                    cnt <= cnt + 1;
                end
            end
            5: begin // Set DDRAM address to the first character position
                if (cnt == 15) begin
                    lcd_data <= 8'h80;
                    lcd_rw <= 0;
                    lcd_rs <= 0;
                    execute;
                    state <= 6;
                    cnt <= 0;
                end
                else begin
                    cnt <= cnt + 1;
                end
            end
            6: begin // Write character data
                if (clk_div[11]) begin
                    lcd_data <= dat;
                    lcd_rw <= 0;
                    lcd_rs <= 1;
                    execute;
                    state <= 7;
                    cnt <= 0;
                end
            end
            7: begin // Write another character data
                if (clk_div[11]) begin
                    lcd_data <= dat;
                    lcd_rw <= 0;
                    lcd_rs <= 1;
                    execute;
                    state <= 6;
                    cnt <= 0;
                end
            end
        endcase
    end
end

task execute;
    begin
        lcd_e <= 1;
        #1;
        lcd_e <= 0;
        #5;
    end
endtask

endmodule
